EGY.note: P1 is described as the government's own centre; no renting to other organisations stated.

facts.fact: Al-Dostour reports that the government data and cloud centre P1 took over running government services and routing data after the July 2025 Ramses exchange fire in Cairo.

facts.fact: Al-Dostour reports that the government data and cloud centre P1 runs government services and acts as the active alternative to the main government centre in the New Administrative Capital.
